# SPDX projection 3 byte pin

`fixture.spdx.json` was generated by main `7ca2235fd4e5818dff24e4c94b3e956d7272c305`
(before SPDX projection 4) from `fixture_bom()` in `tests/test_export_conformance.py`,
with `SPDXGenerator().generate_json(...)` and a trailing newline. The projection marker
`spdx-3.0.1/3` promises these bytes: re-projecting the recovered inventory must
reproduce them exactly. Do not regenerate it with the current generator to repair a test.
